tex_content.html:
Proposition
[irreducible decomposition of two-tensors] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0103, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0104 1. ch11:11.7\group Orthogonal Representations As an orthogonal $O(n)$-representation, \[ E\otimes E=\Lambda ^2E\oplus S^2_0E\oplus \mathbb R\operatorname {id}. \]
Proof

\sketch Every endomorphism is uniquely the sum of a skew-adjoint and a self-adjoint endomorphism, and every self-adjoint endomorphism is uniquely the sum of its trace-free part and a scalar multiple of the identity. These summands are pairwise orthogonal and invariant under conjugation by $O(n)$. Their irreducibility is the standard irreducibility of $\Lambda ^2E$ and $S^2_0E$ as real orthogonal representations, with the scalar summand one-dimensional.

□
